name: sn

messages.content: Fit flat LCDM to Pantheon+ with fit_sn_cosmology (z>0.01) and plot the Hubble diagram. Report Om +/- sigma.

Fitting flat LCDM to Pantheon+ (z>0.01) and building the Hubble diagram — will report Omega_m next.

Flat $\Lambda$CDM fit to Pantheon+ (z > 0.01, calibrators included) completed locally:

**Result:** `fit_sn_cosmology` with full stat+sys covariance, offset $M/H_0$ marginalised analytically:

- $N = 1590$ SNe, dof = 1588
- $\chi^2_{\rm min} = 1402.9$
- Best-fit: $\Omega_m = 0.332$
- Marginal posterior: $\Omega_m = 0.332 \pm 0.018$ (mean $0.3323$, sd $0.0182$, 68% HPD $[0.313, 0.350]$, no prior-edge hit)

Consistent with Brout+22 sanity value $0.334 \pm 0.018$.

Files:
- Summary: `/Users/nramachandra/hep-genesis-testing/projects/ramp-cosmo/runs/261104_031015/fit_pantheonplus_lcdm_ddf384_summary.json`
- 1D posterior: `fit_pantheonplus_lcdm_ddf384_1d_Om.csv`
- Hubble diagram: `/Users/nramachandra/hep-genesis-testing/projects/ramp-cosmo/runs/261104_031015/hubble_pantheonplus_8b3f59.png` (Figure 3)

Hubble diagram (Figure 3) shows 1590 Pantheon+ points vs fiducial flat $\Lambda$CDM $\Omega_m=0.3$ (top: $\mu(z)$, bottom: residuals with best-fit offset $-0.109$ mag removed, RMS $0.154$ mag). Grey points are diagonal errors; coloured points are 20 full-covariance binned residuals. Only the shape of $\mu(z)$ is constrained (absolute magnitude degenerate with $H_0$).

[Tool ledger: fit_sn_cosmology returned Om=0.3316 best-fit, mean 0.3323±0.0182, chi2 1402.92, N1590; plot_hubble_diagram returned hubble_pantheonplus_8b3f59.png, offset -0.1086 mag, rms 0.1539 mag]
